sourceReview.reason: Six-hour retry hold: full November 19, 2026 BSC News report (republished verbatim by CryptoCompass and Binance Square) attributes the approximate 0.01% estimate to BlackRock researcher Will Su, based on $30–40 billion on-chain RWA against over $300 trillion in stocks and bonds. However no direct dated BlackRock statement or second independent full-text report confirming that attribution was found; syndicated copies are not independent evidence. BlackRock August 4 primary release concerns separate tokenized money-market share classes. The original attribution and a distinct new event remain unverified. Do not publish; retry no sooner than six hours after reviewedAt.
